The '''Louise Hay Award''' is a mathematics award planned in 1990 and first issued in 1991 by the [[Association for Women in Mathematics]] in recognition of contributions as a math educator.
The award was created in honor of [[Louise Hay (mathematician)|Louise Hay]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://awm-math.org/awards/hay-award/|title=Louise Hay Awards|publisher=Association for Women in Mathematics|website=awm-math.org|access-date=2019-03-19}}</ref>
